plan.purpose: Follow-up only when the completed broad rain search has no broader-validation shortlist. Test interaction of three separated fitted rain settings with the globally shared background westerly amplitude, motivated by retained native circulation errors. No regional coefficient, planetary retune or altered accuracy weights.
plan.physical_definition: Allow only the three parent shared storm/rain coefficients and westerly_speed to differ from the environmental control. Preserve environmental6K/km, independent water, corrected rain/recycling and every other actual parameter. Wind is background peak amplitude, not measured column speed; all coupled fields respond. Same hard invariant and reference checks, identical soft prediction objective and shortlist criteria.
plan.control: 84 actual Earth integrations: seven original r39 controls, seven archived common-mass fixed-profile controls, seven corrected moist original-wind controls and seven archived environmental 6.0 controls, then eight declared shared-parameter combinations on the same seven development regions. All 28 controls precede candidates and reproduce every archived main NPZ fieldset and array exactly. Separate PNW native companions are still recorded and hash-verified. Iberia humidity retains transport_control as its denominator; PNW wind and humidity retain column_control. Neither denominator is replaced by the failed environmental control.
plan.screen: Newpolicy: assess hard physical/structural eligibility separately from observational skill. Noindividualregion, nativehumidity orSST prediction-errorveto duringoptimization. Penalize average andregional/native/oceanregret explicitly; report every raw error and original strict-gate violation ascontext in publication. Missing/nonfinite scores, unpairedcases/footprints and changedfixedparameters failclosed. No alteration ofoldcampaignresults.
plan.advance: This is a fixed small paired interaction bracket, not a global four-dimensional optimization. No adaptive extension and no local polish. Any shortlist still requires separately frozen broader Earth validation and world qualification before adoption.
plan.publication: All fixed wind/rain combinations, original7.5m/s parent anchors, numerical failures and all skill components. Source aliases are frozen archived comparisons, not new integrations. Preserve parent global-search outcomes; no automatic climate adoption.

design.local_rule: No local refinement in this small interaction study; empty poll order. Common runner records the best point only; it proposes no local trials.

objective.definition: Equal-region mean0.5*(TMAE/Tref+rainloss/rainref), plus0.25mean(max(regional_combined-1.05,0)^2), plus0.05mean(max(native_normalized_regression,0)^2), plus0.05mean(max(ocean_normalized_regression,0)^2). Native wind,PW,qshape errors versus fixed transportcontrol(NI,Iberia,EA) or correctedoriginalwindcontrol(PNW), denominatorsmax(baseline,.5m/s,1mm,.02qratio) respectively. Ocean error versusr39/max(baseline,.1C). Denominator floors are predeclared normalization scales, NOT measured reference uncertainty. No skill error vetoes physical eligibility.

validation_shortlist.scope: At mosttwo candidates may advance to separately frozen broader validation; these are research screening thresholds, not adoption. Fifteenpercent regional combined cap permits bounded tradeoffs, unlike earlier2percentveto. Do not change after outcomes. All scores/failures remain visible.

plan.source_policy: Commitplan/script/tests before any new Earth integration. Freeze allparent protocol scientificsources plusnewsource/plan/controlrows/arrays, recheck everyprofile andcompletion. Preserve failures. No simultaneous edits to frozen sources. Eachactualintegrationincludingcontrols counts; cached local proposals do not.

anchor_selection.local_rule: Choose up to three physically admissible global candidates, ordered by objective, at least0.35apart in normalized coordinates. Six sequential coordinate proposals per start; update center only for a strictly improved objective. Clip within original bounds; exact duplicate parameter dictionaries reuse existing records and add no integrations. At most18newlocalprofiles. No convergence/optimality claim.

wind_interaction.scope: Best separated parent rain settings; a conditional interaction test, not new independent validation or a global optimum.
